head_commit.message:
wp1342: hai primitive Windows dung rieng _1174_win_read / _1174_win_volume (r1, chua noi day)

Dac ta ops/specs/WP1174-WINDOWS-BACKEND-r1.md (sha256 bcae8d15...), lease
wp1342-r1-g1-claude, base 14f7dd3.

packet_loop.py - CHI THEM dinh nghia, khong ham co san nao goi toi:
- _1174_WIN_FIXED, _1174_win_path, _1174_win_platform (thuan, moi nen).
- _1174_win_api: binding ctypes kernel32 luoi, argtypes/restype tuong minh.
- _1174_win_open / _1174_win_profile / _1174_win_identity: mo OPEN_EXISTING
  khong ke thua; profile NTFS + DRIVE_FIXED do tren chinh handle, doi chieu
  serial voi volume root; dinh danh (serial, FileIndex64, size, LastWriteTime,
  ChangeTime).
- _1174_win_volume: mo chinh reparse point va tu choi no.
- _1174_win_read: so dinh danh luc mo va sau doc, dong handle, mo lai ten va
  doi dinh danh khop truoc khi tra bytes.

packet_loop_test.py - 8 ca wp1342_*, khong vao WP1174_REQUIRED/WP1174_BOTH,
MUTANTS khong doi:
- wp1342_additive_byte_preserved (N2/N3): loai dung cac khoi moi thi phan con
  lai bang nguyen byte blob base; kem 10 phan chung do + 1 xanh, 3 phan chung
  noi day.
- wp1342_pure_platform_path: bang nhan/tu choi cua platform va ten duong dan.
- 6 ca wp1342_native_*: chi do tren Windows; nen khac BO QUA, khong tinh dat.

Do tren Linux: 2 ca thuan dat, 6 ca native BO QUA, 85/85 wp1174_* dat,
ruff F delta 0, adr-song / doctrine-scan / eol_policy rc 0. Ca native CHUA
do tren Windows.

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_015Gtxrb6r8m5N1MbHf4NsyC
